# AI News Hub

> AI News is a free primary-source intelligence index for AI labs, model providers, research organizations, and agent harnesses. It preserves official titles, dates, URLs, and provenance. The core uses no paid AI API.

## Core pages

- [Latest](/): reverse-chronological feed with shareable entity, topic, and text filters
- [Major Updates](/major-updates/): named model releases and major harness versions promoted by a public headline rule
- [Labs and providers](/labs/): registry and coverage ledger
- [Agent harnesses](/harnesses/): official release coverage for Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, OpenHands, coding agents, and provider CLIs
- [Daily digests](/digest/daily/): permanent UTC date archives
- [Weekly digests](/digest/): weekly archive
- [Feeds](/feeds/): public feed builder and machine-readable exports
- [Watchlist](/watchlist/): browser-local entity watchlist, no account
- Entity pages: `/entities/{slug}/`
- Permanent article pages: `/article/{id}/`

## Machine feeds

- [RSS, all updates](/feed.xml)
- [JSON, all updates](/articles.json)
- [RSS, Major Updates](/feed/major.xml)
- [RSS, labs and providers](/feed/labs.xml)
- [RSS, harnesses](/feed/harnesses.xml)
- Entity RSS: `/feed/entity/{slug}.xml`
- Entity JSON Feed 1.1: `/feed/entity/{slug}.json`
- Topic RSS: `/feed/topic/{slug}.xml`
- [Sitemap index](/sitemap-index.xml)

## Provenance and behavior

- First-party sources are canonical.
- Latest is chronological.
- Major Updates has no prestige, engagement, or hidden model score.
- Source records are immutable and existing public routes are preserved.
- Supabase is the live read path. The checked-in verified cache is the degraded fallback.
